legalName: Expungement by Redaction of Records with References to Multiple Individuals (La. C.Cr.P. art. 985)

componentsNotGenerated.conditionTheRecordStates: Generated where the petitioner's underlying entitlement is a non-conviction ground and the Article 983(F) exemption may apply.
componentsNotGenerated.whyNotGenerated: the condition is a participant fact the platform does not hold on either fixture: nothing establishes that the participant may qualify for the Article 983(F) exemption, whose grounds are non-conviction grounds. The record's own words about the exemption, the fifteen-day return and the non-refundable fee are carried in the participant and filing instructions.

componentsNotGenerated.conditionTheRecordStates: Used only where the arrest carries more charges or counts than the Article 989 motion's own fields hold.
componentsNotGenerated.whyNotGenerated: the stated condition is a count that exceeds the Article 989 motion's own fields, and neither fixture establishes it; independently, Article 993 is not in this family's composedFromAuthority grant and the committed legal-design note states in terms that no template exists, none is counsel-approved and no implementation is authorized. The instructions tell a participant with more counts than the motion holds to ask the clerk for the statutory sheet.

routeSelectionNote: This packet is built for exactly one route: expungement BY REDACTION under La. C.Cr.P. art. 985, where the record names more than one individual. The relief the packet asks for is stated on the face of the motion and again on the proposed Article 992 order rather than left as a blank election, and the packet names Article 985 in its own title. The underlying entitlement -- Article 976, 977 or 978 -- is a case fact the platform collects and writes, not an election left blank on the filing, and the instructions tell the participant to check it against their own court record. The Article 985 redaction paragraph itself is the judge's decretal language and is left blank for that reason, not for want of a determination.

routeSelectionsMade.authority: La. C.Cr.P. art. 985, on the Article 989 statutory motion and the Article 992 statutory order which carries the dedicated redaction paragraph
routeSelectionsMade.statedOnTheFaceOfThePacket: the motion is titled and prayed as a request for expungement by redaction under Article 985, and the proposed Article 992 order carries the Article 985 redaction section
